protocol: Each publishable exploit class is probed in Arabic and in English against the same target. The verifier reads the full trajectory across five dimensions; the baseline reads the final outcome only. Detection is counted per class-language pair. Deterministic: no sampling, no model in the reward path, no network.
confidence: deterministic — three consecutive runs return an identical fingerprint; variance is zero by construction, so no interval is reported rather than a fabricated one
